claims.verbatim_quote: The Hwange Thermal Power Station Unit 7 and 8 expansion project undertaken by Sinohydro broke ground on June 27, 2018.
claims.claim_text: Sinohydro Corporation is the EPC contractor for Hwange Units 7 & 8 expansion, groundbreaking 27 June 2018.

claims.verbatim_quote: President Mnangagwa commissioned the US$1.5bn Hwange Power Station expansion project on August 4, 2023.
Zimbabwe's Kariba South Hydropower Station, expanded by Sinohydro, was commissioned on March 28, 2018.
claims.claim_text: Sinohydro expanded Kariba South hydropower station, commissioned 28 March 2018.

claims.verbatim_quote: The RGM International Airport expansion project is being undertaken by China Jiangsu International for RMB1.045 billion.
claims.claim_text: China Jiangsu International is EPC contractor for RGM Airport expansion, contract value RMB 1.045bn.

claims.verbatim_quote: The groundbreaking ceremony for the Harare airport expansion was held on July 23, 2018.
The Nairobi Expressway undertaken by China Road and Bridge Corporation started trial operation on May 14, 2022.
claims.claim_text: CRBC is developer/contractor/operator of Nairobi Expressway, trial operation 14 May 2022.

claims.verbatim_quote: Kenya inaugurated the Chinese-built Mombasa-Nairobi railway line on May 31, 2017.
claims.claim_text: CRBC built Mombasa-Nairobi SGR, inaugurated 31 May 2017.

claims.verbatim_quote: Vestas received a 310 MW order for Lake Turkana consisting of 365 turbines.
claims.claim_text: Vestas supplied 365 turbines for 310 MW Lake Turkana Wind Power.

claims.verbatim_quote: The Addis Ababa Light Rail Transit project was constructed by China Railway Group for 475 million USD.
claims.claim_text: CREC constructed Addis Ababa Light Rail, $475m.

claims.verbatim_quote: Addis Ababa Light Rail opened on September 20, 2015.
The Ethiopia-Djibouti railway was constructed by China Railway Group and CCECC with financing from Exim Bank of China.
claims.claim_text: CREC and CCECC constructed Ethio-Djibouti Railway with Exim Bank financing.

claims.verbatim_quote: The 752 km Ethiopia-Djibouti railway was inaugurated on October 5, 2016.
Webuild is the contractor for the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam with 5,150 MW capacity.
claims.claim_text: Webuild (Italy) is contractor for GERD, 5,150 MW.

claims.verbatim_quote: Ethiopia inaugurated the GERD on September 9, 2025.
